name: Sheet-Pan Smoked Sausage, Broccoli and Cheddar
note: In-band (472 cal / 10.6g total carbs, 6.6g net / 24.7g protein), a DRY sheet-pan roast of smoked sausage + broccoli + cheddar with no sauce and zero starch. Kept as the ONE smoked-sausage-broccoli-cheddar dinner from this batch's pool twin pair: I reject its creamy sibling broccoli-smoked-sausage-cream-cheese-bake because the dry sheet-pan method is genuinely distinct from all three broccoli/sausage accepted items (baked-cauliflower-mac-smoked-sausage is a creamy mac; keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole is a creamy casserole) whereas the creamy sibling collides with both. Boosts the underrepresented pork lane and adds a sheet-pan batch format. American cuisine, so no cuisine-spread gain, but a legitimately distinct dinner, not padding.
